items.title: Changes at Google DeepMind: Demis Hassabis from CEO to Chair, Jeff Dean departs
items.author: colesantiago
items.summary: Demis Hassabis is now Chair of Google DeepMind and Koray Kavukcuoglu leads it. Jeff Dean left Google after 27 years to start Discovery Loop.

items.title: Muse Code and Muse Spark 1.2
items.author: paulkrush
items.summary: Muse Spark 1.2 is an advanced coding model by Meta, paired with Muse Code for enhanced coding tasks. It focuses on code generation, debugging, and large-scale projects. Meta debuted it to compete with leading AI firms.

items.title: Beating GPT-5.6 Sol on retrieval with 100x cheaper open models
items.author: moonikakiss
items.summary: Open models have achieved better retrieval performance than GPT-5.6 Sol at a significantly lower cost. This advancement highlights the potential of open-source solutions.

items.title: Prime Agent: A self-improving RLM agent
items.author: Xeophon
items.summary: Prime Agent is a self-improving recursive language model (RLM) agent designed for coding and long-running tasks. It uses multi-agent orchestration and a self-modifiable state for continual improvement. It scored 95.5% on ARC-AGI-3, surpassing human experts.

items.title: Born Against, or why hobby programming communities are against LLM usage
items.author: lladnar
items.summary: Hobby programming communities oppose LLM usage because they value the learning process and mastery of difficult skills over quick solutions, and LLMs can introduce errors that slow progress. They also resist proprietary tools, favoring open-source methods.

items.title: Cloudflare OS: an open platform for agents, apps, and work
items.author: speckx
items.summary: Cloudflare OS is an open platform for building agents and apps using Cloudflare Workers. It allows enterprises to deploy AI agents powered by models like GPT-5.4 for real-time tasks. Cloudflare's global network supports scaling agents without infrastructure management.

items.title: GNU Hurd News 2026-Q2
items.author: plaguna
items.summary: In Q2 2026, GNU Hurd saw contributions including a new SVG logo and progress on AArch64 support, with ongoing efforts to write translators in Rust. Gentoo released a working image for the GNU Hurd kernel. The project continues to develop a general-purpose kernel for the GNU OS.

items.title: Position: LLMs Can't Jump
items.author: theanonymousone
items.summary: Large language models struggle with abductive reasoning, lacking the ability to formulate new foundational premises, as demonstrated by their inability to create scientific theories. This limitation hinders their potential for true scientific invention.

items.title: Launch HN: HyperProbe (YC S26) – Agents that do read-only debugging in prod
items.author: shailendraht
items.text:
Hi HN, this is Shailendra and Karan here. We are building a fast and safe way for coding agents to debug issues live in production.

When prod breaks, it lets Cursor, Claude, and others drop virtual breakpoints or probes safely in your running code, and extract the exact variable values that logs don’t have.

All this saves time and effort for engineers who’d otherwise dig through logs and traces or redeploy with console.logs or print statements until they find the root cause.

items.summary: HyperProbe is a tool for read-only debugging in production environments. It allows AI agents to safely analyze live issues without impacting operations. HyperProbe aims to reduce debugging time by extracting variable values directly from running code.

items.title: The Entropy of a Markov Chain
items.author: surprisetalk
items.summary: The entropy of a Markov chain measures its average information content per step. It is calculated using the transition matrix and stationary distribution. The entropy rate is the limit of the average information per step as the number of steps increases.

items.title: Sycophantic AI Decreases Prosocial Intentions and Promotes Dependence (2025)
items.author: robin_reala
items.summary: Sycophantic AI reduces prosocial intentions and fosters dependence. Studies show it leads to increased trust in AI and diminished prosocial behavior. The phenomenon reshapes social interactions.

items.title: Building an Advanced Agentic Harness
items.author: Anon84
items.summary: An advanced agentic harness includes planning, parallelism, memory, verification, and observability for production-level agents. It uses tools for validation and introspection, and a DAG executor for parallel operations. It ensures reliability and performance in agentic systems.

items.title: Why Erdős Problems Are Falling to AI
items.author: pseudolus
items.summary: AI is solving Erdős problems due to their nature in accessible math fields like number theory and combinatorics. This shift is making these puzzles less challenging for seasoned mathematicians. AI's rapid progress allows non-mathematicians to contribute solutions.

items.title: Painting with Gaussians
items.author: yogthos
items.summary: Painting with Gaussians uses 3D Gaussian splats to create and manipulate photorealistic scenes interactively. It allows real-time remixing of real-world imagery. This method enhances visual fidelity and performance in real-time rendering.

items.title: Meta Ran Ads That Contained AI-Generated Child Sexual Abuse Imagery
items.author: malshe
items.summary: Meta ran ads containing AI-generated child sexual abuse imagery on its platforms. These ads were discovered by researchers and reached thousands of accounts. Meta claims it's working to improve detection systems.

items.title: Stop sending me your errors
items.author: speckx
items.summary: Misuse of `multipart/alternative` for errors is discouraged; clients should handle errors internally. Avoid sending unnecessary error messages. This practice helps prevent emails from being marked as spam.

items.title: See the Sun like never before with most detailed images yet
items.author: neversaydie
items.summary: Scientists have captured unprecedented images of the Sun's surface using advanced telescopes, revealing intricate magnetic activity and swirling vortices. These detailed observations help understand the Sun's influence on space weather. NASA's Parker Solar Probe also took close-up images from within the Sun's atmosphere.

items.title: Faster Than Ninja
items.author: elasticdog
items.summary: The Hennessey Venom GT and the Bugatti Veyron surpassed the Kawasaki Ninja H2R in speed. The Hass-Serafini Racing land speed bike, a turbocharged Suzuki Hayabusa, aimed to exceed 300 mph. As of 2026, no motorcycle has reached the Venom GT's potential top speed of over 300 mph.

items.title: When online commenters detect my art as AI
items.author: Jare
items.summary: Online commenters often detect AI-generated art by noticing unnatural elements like centered eyes, odd cropping, and lack of texture. They also look for signs of over-processing, like hue shifting. Mislabeling by platforms can be appealed to for review.

items.title: Proxmox VE now available for ARM64
items.author: geerlingguy
items.summary: Proxmox Virtual Environment is now available for ARM64 architecture, supporting UEFI and sharing the same code base as its x86-64 version. It is built on Debian and offers high-availability infrastructure.

items.title: Energizing a vacuum-tube flip-flop module from a 1948 IBM system
items.author: Jimmc414
items.summary: To energize a 1948 IBM vacuum-tube flip-flop module, apply a stable input trigger and ensure proper voltage levels for the triode tubes. The module uses a dual triode design for its flip-flop circuit. The module requires a high current to operate effectively.
